name: tw-legal-function-calling-bench
description: A legal-domain benchmark that tests models' ability to produce correct function‑call outputs given legal queries: mapping natural language legal questions to structured API/function invocations with correct arguments. It evaluates correctness of the generated call signatures and field values in legal information retrieval scenarios.
reputation: A niche dataset focused on legal function‑calling; of interest to researchers working on structured output and legal NLP but not yet widely adopted.
